citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
The facility reviewed the program for humane care and use of animals on June 16, 2025, and March 6, 2026. This period
of time exceeds the maximum of six months permitted between program reviews. Exceeding the maximum time permitted
between program reviews does not allow full IACUC oversight of activities involving animals. The facility must ensure that
the program for humane care and use of animals is reviewed at least once every six months. To be corrected by
September 20, 2026, or the next semiannual program review.

citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
The facility inspected the animal facilities on June 16, 2025, and March 6, 2026. This period of time exceeds the
maximum of six months permitted between facility inspections. Exceeding the maximum period of time permitted between
facility inspections does not allow full IACUC oversight of facilities involved in the use of animals. The facility must ensure
that the animal facilities are inspected at least once every six months. To be corrected by September 20, 2026, or the next
facility inspection.

citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
The facility prepared reports of its semiannual program review and facility inspection to the institutional official (IO) on
June 16, 2025, and March 6, 2026. This period of time exceeds the maximum of six months permitted between these
reports. Exceeding the maximum period of time permitted between semiannual program review and facility inspection
reports prevents the IO from being fully apprised of activities involving animals. The facility must ensure that semiannual
reports are prepared for the IO at least once every six months. To be corrected by September 20, 2026, or the next
semiannual program review and facility inspection.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
